_comment: PII regression cases drawn from real user-reported leaks. Each row is a value that should be flagged by the heuristic engine with a meaningful category for the Pass 2 review UI. Sources: issues #47, #49.

heuristic_regression_cases.source: issue #49 — Netgear C7000v2 RouterStatus.htm serial format [0-9][A-Z]{2}[0-9]{4}[A-Z0-9]{6}
issue #47 — default password format with prefix word + digits + suffix
issue #47 — SN-HERE placeholder; representative 12-char uppercase-alphanumeric serial token covered by the broader serial_number backstop

_followup_regex_layer: WPS PIN (8 bare digits) belongs in the regex layer — see regex_layer_regression_cases below. Heuristics can't disambiguate a WPS PIN from a packet counter; the adjacent label is what makes 100% confidence achievable per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § Confidence boundary.
